commands.name: artifact
commands.description: Read, sample, search, or pick local artifact files produced by browser tools without loading the whole file, including bounded multi-artifact search.

notes: JSON results that include saved.path are enriched with artifacts[] descriptors; cliNextActions[] only carries non-duplicate executable follow-ups.
Large or sensitive raw payloads stay in local artifacts; read bounded paths with browser-pilot artifact.

flags.name: path
flags.description: Artifact path returned by a browser tool, absolute or relative to cwd

flags.name: paths
flags.description: Explicit artifact paths for bounded multi-artifact search mode. Accepts comma-separated values or a repeated flag.

flags.name: root
flags.description: Optional relative root under .browser-pilot/artifacts for bounded multi-artifact search.

flags.name: glob
flags.description: Optional bounded glob for multi-artifact search, e.g. **/*.json

flags.name: mode
flags.description: text | json | search | sample

flags.name: offset
flags.description: Line offset for text/search; item offset for json arrays; character offset for json scalar strings

flags.name: limit
flags.description: Line count for text/sample; item/key limit for json arrays/objects; character limit for json scalar strings

flags.name: jsonPath
flags.description: Simple dot/bracket path for json mode; when provided without mode, read defaults to json. Missing paths return exists:false/notFound:true. Browser tool artifacts usually keep primary results under data, e.g. data, data.items, data.links.

flags.name: pick
flags.description: Multiple simple JSON paths; repeat --pick path for each path in the CLI (not a JSON array string). Results stay aligned one entry per requested path.

flags.name: query
flags.description: String or bounded safe-regex query for search mode; when provided without mode and without jsonPath/pick, read defaults to search.

flags.name: regex
flags.description: Treat query as a bounded regular expression; unsafe patterns are rejected

flags.name: ignoreCase
flags.description: Case-insensitive search unless false

flags.name: contextLines
flags.description: Context lines around search matches

flags.name: contextChars
flags.description: Character window around long-line search matches or single-line samples; bounded internally.

flags.name: columnOffset
flags.description: text mode only: zero-based character offset within each selected line for long single-line artifacts.

flags.name: columnLimit
flags.description: text mode only: maximum characters to return from columnOffset within each selected line.

flags.name: maxMatches
flags.description: Maximum search matches

flags.name: maxFiles
flags.description: Maximum files scanned for bounded multi-artifact search.

flags.name: maxBytes
flags.description: Maximum total bytes scanned for bounded multi-artifact search.

flags.name: maxMatchesPerFile
flags.description: Maximum search matches retained per file in bounded multi-artifact search.

flags.name: maxTotalMatches
flags.description: Maximum total matches retained across all files in bounded multi-artifact search.

commands.name: callback-oast
commands.description: Run local HTTP/HTTPS/DNS callback listeners with correlation IDs, trigger helpers, persisted events, and external callback metadata.

notes: JSON results that include saved.path are enriched with artifacts[] descriptors; cliNextActions[] only carries non-duplicate executable follow-ups.
Large or sensitive raw payloads stay in local artifacts; read bounded paths with browser-pilot artifact.

flags.name: action
flags.description: start | list | status | collect | clear | trigger | stop. Default start.

flags.name: sessionId
flags.description: Logical callback listener session id. Required for status/collect/clear/trigger/stop.

flags.name: listenHost
flags.description: Local listen host; default 127.0.0.1. Use 0.0.0.0 to listen on all interfaces.

flags.name: port
flags.description: Local HTTP listen port; default 0 chooses an ephemeral port.

flags.name: publicBaseUrl
flags.description: Optional externally reachable HTTP base URL to combine with the generated callback path.

flags.name: publicHttpsBaseUrl
flags.description: Optional externally reachable HTTPS base URL to combine with the generated callback path.

flags.name: basePath
flags.description: Callback path template. {{correlationId}} is replaced; default /__browser_pilot_oast/{{correlationId}}.

flags.name: correlationId
flags.description: Correlation id to embed in generated callback URLs/hosts; default random.

flags.name: responseStatus
flags.description: HTTP/HTTPS status returned by the callback listener; default 200.

flags.name: responseBody
flags.description: HTTP/HTTPS response body returned by the callback listener; default ok.

flags.name: responseHeaders
flags.description: HTTP/HTTPS response headers returned by the callback listener.

flags.name: enableHttps
flags.description: Also start a local HTTPS callback listener with a self-signed certificate.

flags.name: httpsPort
flags.description: Local HTTPS listen port; default 0 chooses an ephemeral port.

flags.name: enableDns
flags.description: Also start a local UDP DNS callback listener.

flags.name: dnsListenHost
flags.description: Local DNS listen host; defaults to listenHost.

flags.name: dnsPort
flags.description: Local DNS listen port; default 0 chooses an ephemeral port.

flags.name: dnsBaseDomain
flags.description: Generated DNS callback base domain used for dnsCallbackHost, e.g. oast.test.

flags.name: publicDnsBaseDomain
flags.description: Optional externally reachable DNS base domain used for publicDnsCallbackHost.

flags.name: dnsResponseAddress
flags.description: IPv4 address returned for A queries handled by the local DNS listener; default 127.0.0.1.

flags.name: externalMetadata
flags.description: Optional external tunnel/provider metadata stored with the session and returned in status/list results.

flags.name: mode
flags.description: trigger only: http | https | dns. Default http.

flags.name: target
flags.description: trigger only: explicit target URL or DNS name; otherwise the current session callback URL/host is used.

flags.name: method
flags.description: trigger only: HTTP/HTTPS method; default POST.

flags.name: requestHeaders
flags.description: trigger only: HTTP/HTTPS request headers.

flags.name: body
flags.description: trigger only: HTTP/HTTPS text body.

flags.name: bodyBase64
flags.description: trigger only: HTTP/HTTPS base64 body for binary-ish payloads.

flags.name: queryName
flags.description: trigger only: DNS query name override; aliases target for dns mode.

flags.name: queryType
flags.description: trigger only: DNS query type; default A.

flags.name: resolverHost
flags.description: trigger only: DNS resolver host override; defaults to the current session DNS listener host.

flags.name: resolverPort
flags.description: trigger only: DNS resolver port override; defaults to the current session DNS listener port.

flags.name: rejectUnauthorized
flags.description: trigger only: HTTPS certificate verification flag. Default false for the local self-signed listener.

flags.name: maxEvents
flags.description: Maximum persisted callback events per session; default 1000, hard-capped at 100000.

flags.name: maxRuntimeMs
flags.description: Maximum worker lifetime in milliseconds before the local callback listener self-stops; default 3600000, hard-capped at 86400000.

flags.name: afterSeq
flags.description: collect only: return callback events with seq greater than this value.

flags.name: triggerTimeoutMs
flags.description: trigger only: wait timeout in milliseconds for the triggered callback event to be persisted.

flags.name: targetRef
flags.description: Stable target reference from browser_tabs list/create (tabHandle). Preferred over numeric tabId because it survives unambiguous in-place tab replacement.

flags.name: action
flags.description: Collection mode (default: crawl). crawl: recursive discovery; fingerprint: single-shot metadata.

flags.name: tabId
flags.description: Compatibility target used when bindBrowserSession injects browser cookies into HTTP requests; prefer targetRef/tabHandle when provided.

flags.name: targetRef
flags.description: Stable target reference from browser_tabs list/create (tabHandle). Preferred over numeric tabId because it survives unambiguous in-place tab replacement.

flags.description: Allow requests to private, link-local, or cloud-metadata-adjacent targets. Default false; loopback remains allowed for local fixtures and callback listeners.

flags.description: Single seed URL or host. Host-only input uses defaultScheme.

flags.name: urls
flags.description: Bounded list of seed URLs or hosts. Accepts comma-separated values or a repeated flag.

flags.name: paths
flags.description: Optional seed paths to resolve against each target URL. Accepts comma-separated values or a repeated flag.

flags.name: headers
flags.description: Optional request headers object.

flags.name: method
flags.description: fingerprint mode only: HTTP method for probing; default GET.

flags.name: ports
flags.description: fingerprint mode only: optional ports to apply to each target URL. Accepts comma-separated values or a repeated flag.

flags.name: schemes
flags.description: fingerprint mode only: optional schemes to expand, e.g. [http, https]. Accepts comma-separated values or a repeated flag.

flags.name: includeFaviconHash

flags.name: includeTlsCertificate

flags.name: sameOrigin
flags.description: crawl mode only: stay within seed origins; default true.

flags.name: knownFiles
flags.description: crawl mode only: none | robotstxt | sitemapxml | all. Adds common known-file seeds.

flags.name: extractJs
flags.description: crawl mode only: extract JS endpoint hints and crawl same-origin script files; default true.

flags.name: activeGraphqlIntrospection
flags.description: crawl mode only: actively POST a standard GraphQL introspection query only to URLs/content-types that look like GraphQL; default true. Set false for passive-only GraphQL parsing.

flags.name: bindBrowserSession
flags.description: Inject browser cookies for crawl/fingerprint requests into outgoing HTTP request headers; default false.

flags.description: nuclei mode only: optional nuclei severity selector list passed via -severity.

flags.name: authors
flags.description: nuclei mode only: optional nuclei author selector list passed via -author.

flags.name: har
flags.description: nuclei mode only: HAR object; selected entries are replayed as nuclei bridge targets.

flags.name: harPath
flags.description: nuclei mode only: local HAR JSON file path; selected entries are replayed as nuclei bridge targets.

flags.name: harEntryIndex
flags.description: Zero-based HAR entry index to replay.

flags.name: harUrlPattern
flags.description: Bounded safe-regex or substring filter for HAR request URLs; unsafe regex falls back to substring and candidate entries are capped.

flags.name: requests
flags.description: nuclei mode only: request sequence entries: raw request strings, captured requests, HAR entries, or replay option objects. Each selected entry is sent to nuclei as a separate target.

flags.name: sequence
flags.description: nuclei mode only: alias for requests; each selected entry is sent to nuclei as a separate target.

flags.name: retries
flags.description: nuclei mode only: retry count; default 1.

flags.name: concurrency
flags.description: nuclei mode only: concurrency via -c; default 10, clamped to 1-100.

flags.name: bulkSize
flags.description: nuclei mode only: bulk size via -bs; default 10, clamped to 1-100.

flags.name: bindBrowserSession
flags.description: Merge browser cookies into outgoing HTTP request headers for request URLs; default false.

commands.name: upload
commands.description: Upload local file(s) through a page file chooser using CDP DOM.setFileInputFiles.

notes: JSON results that include saved.path are enriched with artifacts[] descriptors; cliNextActions[] only carries non-duplicate executable follow-ups.
Large or sensitive raw payloads stay in local artifacts; read bounded paths with browser-pilot artifact.

flags.name: tabId
flags.description: Compatibility target: numeric tabId or stable tabHandle string. Prefer targetRef/tabHandle from browser_tabs list; omit to use the selected active tab.

flags.name: targetRef
flags.description: Stable target reference from browser_tabs list/create (tabHandle). Preferred over numeric tabId because it survives unambiguous in-place tab replacement.

flags.name: selector
flags.description: CSS selector for the file input, label, or button that opens the file chooser.

flags.name: files
flags.description: One or more absolute local file paths.

flags.name: index
flags.description: Zero-based match index when selector matches multiple elements; default 0.

flags.name: confirm
flags.description: Must be true to confirm the user approved uploading these exact local file path(s).

commands.name: wait

notes: JSON results that include saved.path are enriched with artifacts[] descriptors; cliNextActions[] only carries non-duplicate executable follow-ups.
Large or sensitive raw payloads stay in local artifacts; read bounded paths with browser-pilot artifact.
